Precognition through a repaired pane.

At the start of a scene (combat encounter, tense negotiation, or major exploration beat), roll 2d20 in secret and record the results as refraction dice.

  • Before any creature (including you) rolls a 2d10x10 for an attack, attribute check, or defense check, you may choose to replace that roll with one of your stored refraction dice.
  • You must decide before the 2d10x10 is rolled. Once used, a refraction die is expended.
  • You refresh your refraction dice at the start of each new qualifying scene.

Strategic Layer. Once per Strategic Turn, you may spend 1 Intrigue OP to force an enemy faction to reroll one of its strategic 2d10x10-based checks (GM chooses the exact check if multiple candidates exist). You must accept the new result.

⟁ Per-Use Ability — Foresight Refraction
Recovery: 2d20/scene + 1/Strategic Turn  ·  Action: Free (declare before 2d10x10)  ·  Use: Click this feature on your sheet to invoke.
At scene start, roll 2d20 in secret as refraction dice. Before any 2d10x10 (yours or anyone's) replace it with one stored die — declared before the roll. Strategic: 1/Turn, spend 1 Intrigue OP to force an enemy faction reroll.
